q1_issues.issue: (Member (sk_dim_lanterns $h) dim) predicates the descriptive modifier 'dim' of the group symbol itself, which Categorical statements explicitly bars — a descriptive modifier or copular predicate on a plural always goes through the distributive rule, never a bare (Member <group> <prop>).

q2_gaps: a definite plural restricted by a relative clause ('the nightmoths that survive the hunt') as the consequent subject of a whenever rule — the instruction set prescribes a group witness for definite plurals and per-member variables for explicit universals, but does not say which applies here
'toward' as a directional oblique — Goal is defined for 'to / into / onto' plus the whither test, while the surface-preposition rule elsewhere forbids synonym heads, so 'toward' is left unresolved
notes: The hunt event variable is correctly reused as the antecedent of the definite 'the hunt', and the flee Skolem (sk_flee $n $h) is properly indexed by the trigger occurrence.
